tools.name: explain_term
tools.description: Look up a trading or market term (for example 'stop-limit order', 'bid-ask spread', 'yield curve') in ATLAS Explain's plain-language glossary. Education only.

tools.name: browse_glossary
tools.description: List ATLAS Explain's learning path (topics in order, each with its terms) or every glossary term in one group. Use it to suggest what to learn next, or to find the right term to explain.

tools.name: asset_details
tools.description: Everything ATLAS Explain shows about one asset: what it is, where and when it trades, its latest official figure or price (with source and time), or why no price is shown. Covers crypto, US stocks and ETFs, currencies, interest rates, energy, indices, futures and options.

tools.name: official_figures
tools.description: Official figures ATLAS Explain publishes from free government and regulator sources: US Treasury yields, ECB and Bank of Canada rates, EIA energy prices, and the latest SEC-filed figures (revenue, net income and more) for large US companies and ETFs. Each has its source and date. Optional search by

tools.name: crypto_prices
tools.description: Recent prices for the ten major coins ATLAS Explain follows (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, Cardano, Dogecoin, Litecoin, Polkadot, Chainlink, Avalanche), biggest moves first. Collected hourly by ATLAS Explain's data job from Kraken's public market data (CoinGecko as backup) and served from ATLAS Ex

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: How a coin's price moved over the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days: start, end, change, high and low with their times, from the hourly closes on ATLAS Explain's own data site (refreshed hourly). Describes the past only; never a forecast.

tools.name: todays_headlines
tools.description: Recent market headlines ATLAS Explain collected from the GDELT Project's news index and from official press releases (Federal Reserve, SEC, CFTC, ECB), each with its publisher, link and time. News stories older than 36 hours and releases older than 4 days are never returned. Optional filter by compa
